Your cookie choice. And all settings. For example colors, font, and language. Then the page loads again.
data.resetFailedDetail: Something went wrong. Please try again.
data.resetSuccessDetail: All your data and settings are deleted now. The page loads again in a moment.

font.title: Font
font.description: Choose the font you like reading best. All fonts are free to use. Your selection is saved on this device. For languages with other scripts (for example Hindi, Bengali, Korean, or Punjabi), Noto Sans is used automatically.

system.note: The font from your device. It does not load anything extra. It looks slightly different on every computer.

sourceSans3.note: A calm and friendly font. Easy to read, even in long texts. Recommended for most people.

inter.note: A clear and modern font. You may know it from many other websites and apps.

ibmPlexSans.note: A calm font with clear letters and numbers. It looks a bit technical.

bricolageGrotesque.note: A special font with its own character. It stands out a bit more than the others.

atkinsonHyperlegible.note: A font that is especially easy to read. It helps if you cannot see very well or if reading is hard for you. But: it only helps with Latin script. For Hindi, Bengali, Korean, and Punjabi there is no such font yet. Noto Sans is used there.

andika.note: A very clear and friendly font. It was made for people who are just learning to read. The letters are large and easy to see. It helps when reading is tiring for you. For example if you find it hard to focus or if your eyesight is getting worse.

lexend.note: A font that has been tested by scientists. It helps you read better. It looks almost normal. But it helps you read faster and more easily.

openDyslexic.note: A special font for people with dyslexia. The letters have a thick bottom. This helps you tell them apart. For example b and d. The look is unusual. But it helps many people with dyslexia a lot.

privacy.dataControlDetail: You have full control over your data. You can turn off progress saving, download your data, or delete everything at any time.
privacy.dataInfoDescription: Learn more about what data is stored.
privacy.dataTransmissionDetail: Your learning progress stays in your browser and is never sent to servers. If you allow statistics, anonymous numbers (which pages, how long) are sent to our own server — not to other companies.

dataType.quizProgress: Finished quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths (only if you say yes)

privacy.description: Control how your learning progress is stored.
privacy.progressDescription: Save which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you finished. Only in your browser. It is off until you turn it on.
privacy.storageLocationDetail: Your learning progress (finished quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths) stays in your browser. It is only saved if you say yes. It does not leave your device. If you allow statistics, anonymous usage numbers are sent to our server (see cookie settings).
privacy.title: Privacy and Progress
privacy.trackingDisabledDetail: All existing progress has been deleted and new progress will not be saved.
privacy.trackingEnabledDetail: Your finished quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths are now saved. Also what you did before in this visit.
privacy.cookieSettingsDescription: Here you can change your choice at any time. The same button is at the bottom of every page: "Cookie settings".

werkbund.name: Werkbund
werkbund.description: Straight edges and a strong red. This style looks plain and clear. It is good for work.

lernwerkstatt.name: Lernwerkstatt
lernwerkstatt.description: Round shapes and a font that is easy to read. This style looks friendly. It is good for learning.

skizzenbuch.name: Skizzenbuch
skizzenbuch.description: Warm paper and thin lines. This style looks hand-drawn. It is good for trying things out.

blaupause.name: Blaupause
blaupause.description: Thin lines and a blue grid. This style looks like a building plan. It is good for looking things up.
